caption:
A Mizoram farmer started growing strawberries in 2024. In 2026, the UN picked her as one of 100 agricultural heroes from 131 countries.

ZT Lalrithangi, a farmer and former teacher from Sangau village in Mizoram's Lawngtlai district, began strawberry cultivation only in 2024. She expanded to over 10,000 plants across two hectares, earning more than Rs 10 lakh in 2025 and now also produces strawberry wine and candy sold in local markets. In October 2026, the UN Food and Agriculture Organization honoured her as one of its 100 Women Heroes in Agrifood Systems and Rural Development, selected from over 600 candidates across 131 countries - only two chosen from India and the first ever from the Mizo community. Two years of farming. A room in Rome full of the world's best.
